verdict.rationale: Morph's custom Reflexes let you send your own labeled examples, train a small text classifier in about 30 seconds, and then classify text against it on the same API. That is train-on-your-data-and-serve, but only for narrow classifiers, not fine-tuning of the open-weight chat models Morph hosts. Dedicated endpoints serve catalog models, with no mention of deploying custom fine-tuned weights. Missing for 10: fine-tuning of supported base chat models (e.g. Kimi K3 or other open-weight models) on user data, serving fine-tuned weights via standard or dedicated endpoints, documented training data formats/hyperparameters, and independent hands-on corroboration.
